chapters.title: Shamanic Technomancy
chapters.text: Steward-tribes of the Loom braid spirit and craft. Pulse, totem lattices, and Echo — not furnace magic.

chapters.title: Loom-born Origin
chapters.text: They drummed Spirit Pulse into stone, raised Resonance Totems, and walked ore through Echo until metal remembered the tribe.

chapters.title: What You Build
chapters.text: Drums, ley, and Pulse Resonator for Pulse; totems and Song Bench for songs; seals for rites; Pulse Cells for Spiritgear; Gate Drum for The March.

chapters.title: Spirit Pulse
chapters.text: Rhythmic beats stored by PulseHandlers. Drumheart for bursts; Ley Collector for ambient trickle; Pulse Resonator burns coal for denser beats.

chapters.title: Reading Pulse
chapters.text: Drumheart, Ley, Resonator, and Song Bench report fill and stalls. Not FE/RF.

chapters.title: Drumheart
chapters.text: Empty-hand drum to store Pulse. Redstone edges and idle trickle also add beats.

chapters.title: Charging Cells
chapters.text: Use a Pulse Cell on a Drumheart or Pulse Resonator to transfer up to 25 Pulse per click.

chapters.title: Pulse Cells
chapters.text: Portable buffers (200). Spiritgear, Gate Drum, and Deep Cache can drink them.

chapters.title: Ley Collector
chapters.text: Ambient Pulse tap (~2 / 40 ticks). Song Bench prefers generators before Totem buffers.

chapters.title: Pulse Resonator
chapters.text: Burns coal/charcoal (~4 Pulse / 20 ticks while lit). Feed by right-click; status empty-hand; shift-click removes fuel. Lattice treats it as a generator.

chapters.title: Totem Lattice
chapters.text: Resonance Totems within 8 of a Song Bench. Ritual Chalk seals lasting links within 16 blocks.

chapters.title: Attunements
chapters.text: Earth, Fire, Water, Air, Spirit. Match Echo stages to nearby totems.

chapters.title: Ritual Chalk
chapters.text: Mark two Resonance Totems to seal a bidirectional lattice link.

chapters.title: Lattice Conductor
chapters.text: Near chalk-linked totems: right-click routes Pulse from Drumheart/Ley/Resonator into totem buffers, assists Song Benches, and can move Echo grit to Ancestral Caches.

chapters.title: Song Bench
chapters.text: Seat one feed item, empty-hand click to sing, shift-click to remove.

chapters.title: Song Status
chapters.text: Reports Pulse, totem, and attunement stalls.

chapters.title: Echo Loop
chapters.text: Shatter (Earth) → Attune (Fire) → Bind (Water) → Manifest (Spirit). Live on Song Bench only.

chapters.title: Shatter
chapters.text: Raw ores/cobble/iron-like → Echo Shard under Earth.

chapters.title: Attune
chapters.text: Echo Shard → Attuned Echo under Fire.

chapters.title: Bind
chapters.text: Attuned Echo → Bound Echo under Water; drinks Pulse each tick.

chapters.title: Manifest
chapters.text: Bound Echo → Manifested Ingot under Spirit.

chapters.title: Echo Stations
chapters.text: Shrine markers only — they do not process ores.

chapters.title: Ancestral Cache
chapters.text: Local camp storage for reagents, seals, and cells.

chapters.title: Deep Cache
chapters.text: March-linked vault; Pulse can form a temporary spirit link.

chapters.title: Seals & Rites
chapters.text: Offer elemental seals on a Rite Pedestal; the seal is consumed.

chapters.title: Earth Rite
chapters.text: Guard, root hostiles, firm footing into paths.

chapters.title: Fire Rite
chapters.text: Fire ward, ignite foes, melt ice, light campfires.

chapters.title: Water Rite
chapters.text: Breath, grace, quench flames, moisten farmland.

chapters.title: Air Rite
chapters.text: Soft fall, speed, gust knockback, clear rain.

chapters.title: Spirit Rite
chapters.text: Regen, sight, cleanse, heal allies, reveal foes.

chapters.title: Amplified Rites
chapters.text: 8+ Pulse in cells deepens pedestal workings.

chapters.title: Spiritgear
chapters.text: Pick, axe, shovel, blade fueled by Pulse Cells.

chapters.title: Spiritgear Costs
chapters.text: Mine 2, use-on 1, blade hit 3. Fueled spares durability; blade adds echo damage.

chapters.title: Pulse Attunement
chapters.text: Mining enchantment that raises spirit-tuned efficiency.

chapters.title: Echo Edge
chapters.text: Weapon enchantment: extra damage and Glow mark.

chapters.title: Gate Drum
chapters.text: Charge with Pulse, then travel Overworld ↔ The March.

chapters.title: The March
chapters.text: Otherworld of teal stone, pale woods, blooms, wisps, and walkers.

chapters.title: March Materials
chapters.text: March blocks for builds that remember the otherworld.

chapters.title: Crafting Notes
chapters.text: Chimes, copper resonators, shards unlock machines including the Pulse Resonator; Echo grit comes from the Song Bench.

chapters.title: Camp Layout
chapters.text: Drum, ley, or resonator by the bench; chalk-linked totem ring with Conductor; echo shrines; pedestal hearth; gate at the edge.

chapters.title: Safety
chapters.text: Pulse ≠ FE. Burn coal in a Resonator when ley is thin — keep the drum honest.

chapters.title: Credits
chapters.text: Tribal Power — Ahmi & Risika Darrow. Shamanic Technomancy for steward-tribes of the Loom.
